build_generator: build a StyleGAN Generator that maps latent Z to images using MappingNetwork and SynthesisNetwork
build_discriminator: build a StyleGAN2 Discriminator with resnet architecture and minibatch standard deviation layer
run_modulated_conv2d: run modulated_conv2d to apply style-modulated 2D convolution with demodulation and noise injection
create_mapping_network: create a MappingNetwork that projects latent Z and conditioning C into intermediate W style codes
build_synthesis_network: build a SynthesisNetwork with progressive SynthesisBlocks that generate images from style codes W
